scope: Carbohydrate only. Phase 1 fibre, all other nutrients, energy, ingredients, portions, methods, guidance and classifications are preserved. Local draft; no clinical approval.

methodology.definition: UK-compatible available carbohydrate by weight excluding dietary fibre. CoFID CHO is already available: never subtract fibre from CoFID.
methodology.cofid: Use the selected food starch ME /1.10, free monosaccharides unchanged, disaccharides ME /1.05. An uncharacterised non-starch remainder uses the guide mixed-food /1.05 approximation only with explicit conditional status; no blanket recipe multiplier. Oligosaccharide-dominant foods require chain-length evidence.
methodology.roundingReconciliation: If independently rounded sugar components overshoot L-O, proportionally apply that sugar profile to L-O and flag the adjustment. No missing sugar component is replaced with zero; incomplete profiles use a conditional mixed-remainder approximation.
methodology.usda: Only for documented total carbohydrate by difference: nutrient 205 minus nutrient 291 from the SAME food record. This yields a conditional by-difference approximation, not analytical equivalence to CoFID. No subtraction of NSP or fibre from another food.
methodology.trace: Published Tr retained as trace and counted as zero only at source reporting precision. N and blank remain unknown.
methodology.retained167: Newer167 already use the intended available-by-weight convention. Apply the same selected-food conversion across all317; source-rounding reconciliation and unresolved oligosaccharide-dominant avocado are recorded separately.
methodology.rounding: All317: sum unrounded edible-input contributions then decimal half-up to 0.1 g. Normalise Excel sums to 8 decimals before final rounding to avoid binary tie noise.
methodology.energy: Reported calories are preserved. CoFID energy convention is 3.75 kcal/g carbohydrate ME, not 4 kcal/g available by weight; fibre, organic acids, alcohol and specific Atwater factors prevent a universal 4/4/9 equality check. Numerical energy implications are review prompts, not automatic kcal corrections.

Available carbohydrate by difference, not directly measured available carbohydrate. The residual includes propagated proximate/fibre analytical error and may include organic acids or other non-carbohydrate compounds.

Both nutrients are from the SAME USDA food record (09037), not a matched physical sample or guaranteed matched analytical observations. Fibre has 27 data points and published standard error 0.879 g/100 g; carbohydrate by difference is calculated (source 4, derivation NC), not an independent measurement. No confidence interval for the 1.83 g residual is inferred.

Per 100 g edible raw flesh: skin and seed already excluded. Existing recipe inputs are raw edible weights; do not apply the USDA 26% refuse fraction again. All eight methods use avocado raw at service.

Nutrient-specific substitution for carbohydrate in these eight recipes ONLY. Recipe fibre, calories and all other nutrients retain their existing sources and values. No subtraction from CoFID carbohydrate or substitution of NSP.
